name: Marcus Chen
review: Fantastic service, very happy with my purchase. The sales team was knowledgeable and never pressured me.

name: Denise Foster
review: Terrible experience. They kept adding hidden fees at the last minute and the finance manager was rude.

name: Alan Ortiz
review: Test drove a Mustang here. The car was fine, nothing special about the buying process either way.

name: Brittany Hale
review: Best truck-buying experience I've ever had. Staff went above and beyond to get me the right financing.

name: Wesley Turner
review: Very disappointed. Waited three hours for paperwork and the car had scratches they never disclosed.

name: Priya Nair
review: Came in to look at a Camry. The lot was decent, prices were about what I expected, nothing stood out.

name: Gregory Simmons
review: Fantastic service, very happy with my purchase. Drove off the lot in a new Mustang the same day.

name: Monica Reyes
review: Not a good experience. The salesperson was pushy and the trade-in offer was insultingly low.

name: Tyler Brooks
review: Great selection of trucks and a smooth financing process. Would recommend to friends and family.

name: Sandra Kim
review: Very disappointed with the lack of communication. Nobody returned my calls about the recall issue.

name: Elijah Wong
review: Fantastic service, very happy with my purchase of the Model 3. Delivery was fast and hassle-free.

name: Rachel Adams
review: The Civic runs fine so far. Buying process was average, took longer than I expected but got it done.

name: Nathaniel Price
review: Excellent dealership, super friendly staff and a fair price on my new Mustang. Highly recommend.
